collection.title: Citroen DS4 2011 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen DS4 Hatchback 2011 - 2015 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 30" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this DS4 Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
